additional_info.subject: 0467537 - ID0467537-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/R9 170002450] Check on logs CRM:00472000486
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
The sessions failed because the EV and the charger couldn't establish the communication between each-other.
This can be a problem from the EV or charger. Sometimes dust in the sockets is enough to block the communication.
In this case, the charger already charge successfully after this. Could be a EV problem, I don't see any need to further troubleshoot.
I will proceed to close the ticket.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
